posts.title: Advent of Clojure: NFS 2026
posts.description: This is a sequel to my AoC: NFS blogpost from 2023. Here I’ll further explore some ways to improve the performance of Clojure code, based on my AoC 2025 solutions.

posts.title: Snapshot of my tools
posts.description: This post is aimed at future-me, so he can check in a year or two or five what hardware and software I was using at several points in time. I don’t think it’ll be useful for anybody else, but if it is somehow: let me know how.

posts.title: Advent of Clojure: Need for Speed
posts.description: Advent of Code (AoC) is a series of fun programming challenges, released every December. People solve the tasks in a variety of programming languages, and I find them great for the purpose of learning a new language.
